y-m-59-11.title: Isibalo sixazululwe ngokuphelele ngoba nje kutholwe izixazululo ezimbili?
y-m-59-11.goal: Wazi ukuthi izixazululo zingalahleka ngenkathi isibalo siguqulwa, futhi uhlulele inani lezixazululo ngokuqhathanisa izindlela ezihlukile ezingaphuthelwa yizixazululo esikhaweni.
y-m-59-11.material:
Ufuna ukuthola izixazululo zesibalo u-sin x = sin 2x ku-0 ≤ x ≤ 2π (iziphetho zombili zifakiwe, bala u-x njengezinombolo ezingempela ezihlukile). (Ukufunda: sine x equals sine 2x.) UJimin wakuxazulula kanje.

"Hlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-sin x ukuthola u-1 = 2 cos x, ngakho u-cos x = 1/2. Ku-0 ≤ x ≤ 2π, ama-x anou-cos x = 1/2 angu-π/3 no-5π/3, ngakho kunezixazululo ezimbili."

y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kulungile. Uhlukanise futhi waxazulula, futhi izixazululo ezimbili ziyasebenza, ngakho kunezixazululo ezimbili ngqo

y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi olusha: uma ufaka u-x = 0 esibalweni sokuqala, u-sin 0 = 0 no-sin 0 = 0, ngakho kuyasebenza. Uma ufaka u-x = π, u-sin π = 0 no-sin 2π = 0, ngakho kuyasebenza.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: Isahlulelo sakho sesixazululo sikaJimin sishintsha kanjani ngalolu lwazi?

y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.a: U-x = 0 no-x = π basebenza ngenhlanhla, ngakho akudingeki sibabale njengezixazululo
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uma kusebenza uma kufakwa esibalweni sokuqala, kuyisixazululo. Cabanga ukuthi likhona yini izinga lokukhipha isixazululo njengenhlanhla.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulwazi olusha ukuthi kukhona ezinye izixazululo, hhayi ukuthi izixazululo zikaJimin ziphosile.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Isiphetho sikaJimin siphosile. Kunokwenzeka kakhulu ukuthi izixazululo ezinou-sin x = 0 zanyamalala lapho kuhlukaniswa

y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ngisho nangezixazululo ezintsha, isiphetho sikaJimin sisalungile

y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.info: Ulwazi olusha: sin x − sin 2x = sin x − 2 sin x cos x = sin x (1 − 2 cos x). Ukuze lokhu kube ngu-0, noma sin x = 0 noma 1 − 2 cos x = 0 kumele kugcine.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Lesi sibalo sinezixazululo ezingaki sewonke ku-0 ≤ x ≤ 2π?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma sin x = 0, khona-ke x = 0, π, 2π, futhi uma cos x = 1/2, khona-ke x = π/3, 5π/3. Awekho amanani awelanayo, ngakho kunezi-5 sewonke. (Uma isikhawu bekungu-0 ≤ x < 2π, u-2π ushiywa, okunika abangu-4.)
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Awuzange ubale izixazululo zecala le-sin x = 0, noma ulandele nje isiphetho sikaJimin. Thola u-x one-sin x = 0 esikhaweni.

y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kungenzeka ubale izixazululo kabili. Bhala izixazululo zecala ngalinye eyodwa ngesikhathi esikhaweni bese uhlola ukuthi zikhona yini izinani ezihlangene.

y-m-59-13.title: Uma inani le-log likhulu, ingabe i-argument nayo ikhulu?
y-m-59-13.goal: Qinisekisa ngezimo ukuthi ukuqhathanisa osayizi be-logarithm kuncike ebubanzini besisekelo, sho umbandela lapho isimangalo 'uma inani le-log likhulu, x nayo ikhulu' sigcina khona, bese wakha wena izibonelo zamacala amabili.
y-m-59-13.material:
UJaehee uthe, "Uma log_a x > log_a 3, khona-ke x > 3." (Ifundwa: uma i-log enesisekelo a ka-x ikhulu kuno-log enesisekelo a ka-3.) Isisekelo a singu-a > 0, a ≠ 1, futhi i-argument x ingu-x > 0.

Ithebula linamanani ambalwa.
Isisekelo 2: log_2 1 = 0, log_2 2 = 1, log_2 4 = 2, log_2 3 ≈ 1.58
Isisekelo 1/2: log_(1/2) 1 = 0, log_(1/2) 2 = −1, log_(1/2) 4 = −2, log_(1/2) 3 ≈ −1.58

y-m-59-01.goal: Wazi ukuthi lapho izinkomba zinwetshwa zisuka ezinombolweni zemvelo ziye ku-0 nezinombolo eziphelele ezinegethivu, inani alinqunywa ngokungafanele kodwa isimo esithi 'gcina imithetho esivele ikhona yezinkomba', futhi uhlulele ukuthi kungani indlela efanayo ivinjwa lapho isisekelo singu-0.
y-m-59-01.material:
Amandla angu-2 abhalwe ethebuleni. Cabanga ukuthi amacala lapho inkomba ingu-0 noma inegethivu awakanqunywa.

Inkomba: 4, 3, 2, 1
Inani:   16, 8, 4, 2

(Yifunde ngokuthi: inkomba 4 inika u-16, inkomba 3 inika u-8, njalonjalo.) Ake sicabange isinyathelo ngesinyathelo ukuthi inani kufanele linqunywe kanjani uma inkomba ingu-0, −1, …. Qala ucabange ngecala lapho isisekelo singu-2.
y-m-59-01.thinking.1: Hlola isiqagelo ngesimo esisha futhi ulungise ukuthi uqiniseke kangakanani
y-m-59-01.thinking.2: Thola isimo lapho incazelo ingenzeka khona (isisekelo asisiso u-0)
y-m-59-01.prereq.0: U-'H1' walo msebenzi uphawu kuphela lwezinga lobunzima nokusekela lalesi sinqumo sokukhiqiza; akusho ukuthi uMnyango Wezemfundo unika ikhosi ebangeni elithile. Umcabango: ixazululwa umfundi osevele wafunda okuqukethwe ngezansi.
y-m-59-01.prereq.1: Amandla anezinkomba zezinombolo zemvelo nomthetho wezinkomba u-a^m × a^n = a^(m+n) (u-m no-n bayizinombolo zemvelo)
y-m-59-01.prereq.2: Ukuphindaphinda izingxenyana nokuphambene (inombolo enika u-1 uma iphindaphindwa)
y-m-59-01.s.s1.prompt: Idatha iyembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha umcabango wakho wokuthi kufanele kunqunywe kanjani.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, faka inketho ngayinye ngqo esibalweni futhi uhlole ukuthi ukulingana kuyasebenza yini.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi iphethini yamanani asethebuleni ehla nesimo sokugcina umthetho wezinkomba kukhomba inani elifanayo yini.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Ethebuleni, lapho inkomba iyehla nge-1, amanani angu-16, 8, 4, 2.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: U-2 kumandla angu-0 (2^0, ufundwa: two to the zero) kufanele anqunywe kanjani?
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ethebuleni, isikhathi ngasinye lapho inkomba iyehla nge-1, inani lishuthwa uhhafu (16, 8, 4, 2). Uma le phethini iqhubeka, u-2^0 uhhafu luka-2, okungu-1. Kodwa isiqagelo esicabanga ukuthi iphethini iyaqhubeka, ngakho ake sihlole ngolwazi olulandelayo.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ngu-0. U-2 akazange aphindaphindwe, ngakho akukho okuphindaphindiwe
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthathe u-'akukho okuphindaphindiwe' njengo-0. Bheka nokuthi inani lishintsha kanjani lapho inkomba iyehla ethebuleni.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ngu-1. Qhubeka nephethini lokuthi inani lishuthwa uhhafu isikhathi ngasinye lapho inkomba iyehla nge-1
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthole iphethini yoshintsho ethebuleni futhi wayiqhubekisa ukuqagela inani. Ifaka umcabango wokuthi 'iphethini iyaqhubeka'.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ngu-2. Bhala isisekelo njengoba sinjalo, njengalapho inkomba ingu-1
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi inani lihlala lifana nakuba inkomba yehle nge-1. Qhathanisa ukuthi amanani ashintshe kanjani ezinkombeni ezingu-3, 2, 1.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Iphethini yethebula ivumela ukuqagela, kodwa sidinga ukuhlola kakhulu ukuthi kumele kube leli nani yini
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uhlukanise isiqagelo neqiniso elinqunyiwe. Ukhombise ukuthi iphethini ethebuleni ingubufakazi kodwa ayikabi isivumelwano.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi olusha: sifuna ukuthi umthetho wezinkomba u-a^m × a^n = a^(m+n) osetshenziswa ezinkombeni zezinombolo zemvelo usebenze njengoba unjalo noma inkomba ingu-0 nakho. Isibonelo, u-2^0 × 2^3 = 2^(0+3) = 2^3 kumele usebenze.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ukuze sigcine lesi simo, u-2^0 kumele abe yinombolo muni?
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.after: U-2^0 × 8 = 8, ngakho u-2^0 kumele abe ngu-1. Isiqagelo (1) esivela kuphethini yethebula saqinisekiswa yisimo sokugcina umthetho, futhi inani elingesilo u-1 liphikisana nalesi simo.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uma ufaka u-0 esikhundleni luka-2^0, uba ngu-0 × 8. Hlola ukuthi leli nani lilingana no-2^3 (=8) yini.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uma ufaka u-2 esikhundleni luka-2^0, uba ngu-2 × 8. Hlola ukuthi leli nani lilingana no-2^3 (=8) yini.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uthole wena inombolo enelisa 2^0 × 8 = 8. Cabanga nokuthi lesi sibalo sivumela inombolo eyodwa kuphela yini.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ayimiswanga ibe yinye. Kukhona izinombolo eziningi ezinika u-2^3 uma ziphindaphindwa ngo-8
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Awuhlolanga ukuthi zingaki izinombolo ezinika u-8 uma ziphindaphindwa ngo-8. Xazulula isibalo 8 × □ = 8.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.info: 2^(−1) inqunywa ngendlela efanayo. 2^(−1) × 2^1 = 2^(−1+1) = 2^0 = 1, ngakho 2^(−1) 'yinombolo enika u-1 uma iphindaphindwa ngo-2'. Manje cabanga ngecala lapho isisekelo singu-0. Ake sizame nokunquma u-0^(−1) njenge-'inombolo enika u-0^0 uma iphindaphindwa ngo-0', futhi ukuze kube lula sithi 0^0 = 1.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Noma yini ephindaphindwe ngo-0 ingu-0, ngakho akukho 'nombolo enika u-1 uma iphindaphindwa ngo-0'. Ngakho ukusebenzisa ama-exponent ezinombolo eziphelele ezingemuhle, isisekelo akumele sibe ngu-0. (Ukuthi 0^0 ngokwayo iphathwa kanjani kunezivumelwano ezahlukene ngokwezigaba, ngakho lo msebenzi awuhloli.)
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ayikho. Noma yini ephindaphindwe ngo-0 ingu-0, ngakho ayikwazi ukuba ngu-1
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wahlulele ngokuhlola umphumela wokuphindaphinda wena. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ama-exponent angemuhle adinga umbandela wesisekelo.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ikhona. Khetha nje inombolo encane njengo-0.5
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Bala inani lika-0.5 × 0 wena. Hlola ukuthi umphumela ushintsha yini uma ushintsha inombolo ephindaphindwa ngo-0.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukuthi 1/0 iyinombolo enjani akukanqunywa. Awuhlolanga ukuthi 'inombolo enika u-1 uma iphindaphindwa ngo-0' ikhona ngempela yini.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Bala inani lika-0 × 0 wena. Hlola ukuthi leli nani lingu-1 yini.
y-m-59-01.s.s1.reflect: Ingabe ukuqagela kokuqala kusuka ephethini yethebula kwahlala kunjalo lapho kuhlangana nombandela omusha, noma kwashintsha? Sho ukuthi 'ukuqagela bekulungile' kuhluka kanjani ku-'kumele kube leli nani', nokuthi yimuphi umbandela omusha owadingeka esinyathelweni sokugcina.
y-m-59-01.s.s2.prompt: Umngani uthi, '2^0 ngu-0, ngoba u-2 akazange aphindaphindwe.' Chazela umngani wakho ukuthi kungani 2^0 = 1 inqunyiwe, usebenzisa ucezu olulodwa noma ngaphezulu ludatha engenhla.
y-m-59-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi 2^0 × 2^3 kumele ilingane nani.
y-m-59-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka u-0 owashiwo umngani wakho kuleso sibalo.
y-m-59-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubufakazi obunikeziwe bumisa ngempela inani '2^0 = 1' libe elilodwa, noma usho nje ukuthi ngu-1?
y-m-59-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhombisile lapho kuhluka khona kumcabango womngani wakho ('akukho okuphindaphindwe, ngakho 0')?
y-m-59-01.s.s2.model.0: 2^0 × 2^3 kumele nayo ibe ngu-2^3 ngokomthetho wama-exponent. Uma 2^0 ingu-0, khona-ke 0 × 8 = 8, okungalungile. Ngakho kumele kube ngu-1, onelisa 2^0 × 8 = 8.
y-m-59-01.s.s2.model.1: Ukubuka ithebula, njalo uma i-exponent yehla ngo-1, inani lehliswa libe yingxenye (16, 8, 4, 2). Okulandelayo kuyingxenye ka-2, okungu-1, ngakho 2^0 ngu-1. Uma ibingu-0, iphethini ibizophuka ngokungazelelwe.

y-m-59-02.prereq.0: U-'H1' walo msebenzi uphawu kuphela lwezinga lobunzima nokusekela lalesi sinqumo sokukhiqiza; akusho ukuthi uMnyango Wezemfundo unika ikhosi ebangeni elithile. Umcabango: ixazululwa umfundi osevele wafunda okuqukethwe ngezansi.
y-m-59-02.title: Isixazululo esaphela ngo-−2 = 2 sahamba ngephutha kuphi?
y-m-59-02.goal: Yazi umbandela wokusebenzisa imithetho yama-exponent uma i-exponent iyingxenyana (isisekelo sihle), futhi esixazululweni esinika ukuphikisana, thola futhi ulungise umugqa ophule umbandela.
y-m-59-02.material: UJiyun ubale u-(−8)^(1/3) ngezindlela ezimbili futhi uthi kuphume amanani ahlukile. Funda isixazululo sikaJiyun umugqa nomugqa. (Usizo lokufunda: (−8)^(1/3) ifundwa "negative eight emandleni angu-1/3." I-cube root isho "inombolo i-cube yayo yile nombolo," futhi (−8)^(1/3) emugqeni wokuqala isho le-cube root yangempela.)
y-m-59-02.thinking.0: Thola ukuthi yisiphi isinyathelo esiyinkinga lapho umphumela uwukuphikisana
y-m-59-02.thinking.1: Hlola imibandela lapho umthetho ugcina khona
y-m-59-02.prereq.1: Incazelo ye-cube root: inombolo yangempela enika u-−8 uma i-cube ngu-−2
y-m-59-02.prereq.2: Incazelo yezimpande zesikwele nezimpande ze-n, nencazelo yama-exponent ezingxenyana a^(1/n) = impande ye-n ka-a (a > 0)
y-m-59-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa esixazululweni sikaJiyun lapho kwavela khona inkinga ngoba kwaphulwa umbandela wokusebenzisa umthetho wama-exponent.
y-m-59-02.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula umugqa ngamunye njengomphumela wokubala noma njengomugqa osebenzisa umthetho.
y-m-59-02.s.s1.hint.1: Emigqeni esebenzisa umthetho, hlola ukuthi uphawu lwesisekelo luyini.
y-m-59-02.s.s1.line.0: (−8)^(1/3) yinombolo yangempela enika u-−8 uma i-cube, ngakho ngu-−2.
y-m-59-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 usebenzisa i-exponent 2/6 nakuba isisekelo singesilo esihle (i-exponent eyingxenyana ichazwa uma isisekelo sihle). Umugqa 3 usebenzise (a^m)^n = a^(mn) njengoba unjalo ecaleni elinesisekelo esingemuhle. Ukubala ngokwakho emugqeni 1 (i-cube root ka-−8 ngu-−2) nomugqa 4 (impande yesi-6 ka-64 ngu-2) kulungile. Ngakho ukuphikisana emugqeni 5 akuveli ephutheni lokubala kodwa ekusebenziseni umthetho lapho isisekelo singesilo esihle.
y-m-59-02.s.s2.prompt: Ezimweni ezimaphi ungasebenzisa imithetho yama-exponent ngaphandle kokwenza ukuphikisana? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
y-m-59-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hlela ukukhetha ngakunye ethebuleni ngophawu lwesisekelo nohlobo lwe-exponent (inombolo ephelele, ingxenyana).
y-m-59-02.s.s2.hint.1: Faka izinombolo ezilula ezinketho ezisolwayo bese ubala uhlangothi ngalunye lomthetho ukuqhathanisa.
y-m-59-02.s.s2.o.a: Isisekelo singu-−2 futhi i-exponent iyinombolo ephelele 3
y-m-59-02.s.s2.r.a: Ngisho noma isisekelo singesilo esihle, uma i-exponent iyinombolo ephelele kuyindaba yokuphindaphinda okuphindaphindayo, ngakho umthetho uphephile. Uma uwushiyile lokhu, bala (−2)^3 × (−2)^2 ngqo bese uyiqhathanisa nomthetho wama-exponent.
y-m-59-02.s.s2.o.b: Isisekelo singu-−8 futhi i-exponent iyingxenyana efana no-1/3 noma 2/6
y-m-59-02.s.s2.r.b: Leli yicala elifanayo nesixazululo sikaJiyun. I-exponent eyingxenyana isebenzisa impande ye-n, futhi ngisho nangenani elifanayo, ukushintsha isimo sengxenyana kungashintsha inani.
y-m-59-02.s.s2.o.c: Isisekelo sihle futhi i-exponent iyinoma yiluphi inombolo yengxenyana
y-m-59-02.s.s2.r.c: Uma isisekelo sihle, impande ye-n imiswa njengenani elilodwa, ngakho inani liyafana ngisho noma ushintsha isimo sengxenyana. Uma uwushiyile lokhu, qhathanisa 8^(1/3) no-8^(2/6).
y-m-59-02.s.s2.r.d: 0^(−2) ingu-1/0^2, enesimo sokuhlukanisa ngo-0. Cabanga ukuthi ikhona yini inombolo enika u-1 uma iphindaphindwa ngo-0.
y-m-59-02.s.s2.explain: Uma isisekelo sihle, umthetho uphephile ngisho nakuma-exponent engxenyana, futhi ngisho noma isisekelo singesilo esihle, uphephile uma i-exponent iyinombolo ephelele. Uma isisekelo singesilo esihle futhi i-exponent iyingxenyana, inani lingashintsha ngesikhathi ubhala kabusha ingxenyana ibe yilinganayo, ngakho akumele usebenzise umthetho. Uma isisekelo singu-0 futhi i-exponent ingeyemuhle, ayichazwanga.

y-m-59-02.s.s3.hint.1: Emigqeni esebenzisa umthetho, bhala ukuthi isisekelo sihle noma singesilo esihle.

y-m-59-02.s.s3.model.0: Emigqeni 2 no-3, usebenzise i-exponent eyingxenyana nomthetho wama-exponent kusisekelo esingesilo esihle u-−8. Umthetho wama-exponent engxenyana ungasetshenziswa ngokuphepha kuphela uma isisekelo sihle. Yingakho kwaphela ngo-−2 = 2.

Lo mthetho ungasetshenziswa uma isisekelo sikhulu kuno-0, futhi uma isisekelo singesilo esihle kumele uqale uhlole ukuthi impande ye-n imiswa njengenani elilodwa yini.

y-m-59-03.title: Singasho yini ukuthi 2^100 inamadijithi amangaki ngenani elilinganiselwe kuphela le-log 2?
y-m-59-03.goal: Uma inani le-logarithm evamile liyisilinganiso esiqoqiwe, hlulela ukuthi ububanzi baso beqiniso bumisa isiphetho (inani lamadijithi) libe elilodwa yini, bese usho ukuthi isilinganiso kumele sazeke ngokunemba kangakanani ukuze kunqunywe isiphetho.
y-m-59-03.material:
Ufuna ukuthola nge-logarithm ukuthi 2^100 inamadijithi amangaki. Ungasebenzisi i-calculator.

Isivumelwano: ukuthi inombolo ephelele N inamadijithi angu-k kusho k − 1 ≤ log N < k. (log i-logarithm evamile enesisekelo 10.) Futhi inani le-log 2 linikezwa kuphela njenge-'isilinganiso esiqoqiwe'.

Funda ububanzi isilinganiso esibunikezayo kanje. Isibonelo: 'iqoqwe endaweni yokuqala yedesimali, 0.3' kusho ukuthi inani langempela lingu-0.25 noma ngaphezulu futhi lingaphansi kuka-0.35.
y-m-59-03.thinking.1: Hlulela imibandela lapho isiphetho simiswa khona
y-m-59-03.thinking.2: Sho ukuthi kudingeka ini okunye uma ulwazi lubuthaka
y-m-59-03.prereq.1: Incazelo ye-logarithm evamile (log N yi-power oyiphakamisela ku-10 ukuthola u-N) no-log 2^n = n log 2
y-m-59-03.prereq.2: Inombolo ephelele N inamadijithi angu-k ⇔ k − 1 ≤ log N < k (kukhonjiswa futhi ngaphakathi komsebenzi)
y-m-59-03.prereq.3: Ububanzi bokuqoqa idesimali (uma iqoqwe endaweni yokuqala yedesimali, ±0.05)
y-m-59-03.s.s1.prompt: Isilinganiso siba nolwazi oluqondile kakhulu. Njalo, khetha umcabango wakho ngenani lamadijithi e-2^100.

y-m-59-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uphindaphinde isilinganiso njengokungathi yinani eliyiyo. Futhi, uma log N = 30, inani lamadijithi alingu-30 kodwa linye ngaphezulu. Qala ngokuphindaphinda ububanzi isilinganiso esinabo.

y-m-59-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uphindaphinde ububanzi besilinganiso ngo-100 futhi wahlola ukuthi izinombolo zamadijithi ezingenzeka zibanzi kangakanani. Wahlulele ukuthi ulwazi lubuthaka.

y-m-59-04.goal: Funda kudatha ukuthi umehluko wenombolo eyodwa esikalini se-logarithmic uguqulwa kanjani ube 'yizikhathi', bese uphikisa isimangalo esifunda kabi isilinganiso sezinombolo zesikali njengesilinganiso samakhonsentrishini.
y-m-59-04.material:
Ake sifunde nge-pH, ekhombisa amandla obumuncu. Kulo msebenzi, siyavuma ukuthi esixazululweni esincibilikisiwe samanzi ukukhonsentrisha kwe-hydrogen ion [H⁺] (iyunithi mol/L, 'ama-mole ngelitha') kumiswe ngu-[H⁺] = 10^(−pH). (Ifundwa: 10 emandleni angu-negative pH)

Isixazululo | pH | [H⁺] (mol/L)
A | 3 | 0.001
B | 4 | 0.0001
C | 6 | 0.000001

UDonghyun uthe, "I-pH ye-C ingu-izikhathi ezi-2 ze-pH ye-A, ngakho i-C ayinamuncu ngezikhathi ezi-2 kuno-A."

(I-pH ayidingeki ibe yinombolo ephelele. Uma p ehlukile, kuyisibonelo esihlukile.)

y-m-59-05.topic: Ukwenza imodeli yezinto ezenzeka ngezikhathi ngamagrafu emisebenzi ye-trigonometric
y-m-59-05.goal: Lapho ubhala ukuphakama okuhamba ngezikhathi ngesisho sohlobo lwe-cosine, hlola inqubo lapho isikhungo, i-amplitude nokuhamba kunqunywa ngezimo, bese wakha wena izisho ezimbili ezihlukile (ezinezimpawu ezihlukile) ezanelisa izimo.
y-m-59-05.material:
Umjikelezo we-Ferris wheel ujikeleza ngesivinini esizinzile, ukujikeleza okugcwele okukodwa ngemizuzwana engu-60. Iphoyinti eliphansi kakhulu liphezulu ngo-2 m ngaphezu komhlaba futhi iphoyinti eliphezulu kakhulu liphezulu ngo-30 m ngaphezu komhlaba. Vumela isikhathi lapho umgibeli ekhwela sibe ngu-t = 0 imizuzwana, lapho umgibeli esephoyintini eliphansi kakhulu.

Humusha ukuphakama komgibeli (iyunithi m) njengo-h(t) = D + A·cos(2π(t − c)/60). (Ukufunda: cosine of 2 pi times t minus c over sixty) D ukuphakama kwesikhungo, A yinombolo ebeka i-amplitude (ingaba i-negethivu), futhi c inani lokuhamba ngakwesokudla (imizuzwana). Linciphise libe ngu-0 ≤ c < 60.

y-m-59-14.material: Cabanga ngochungechunge S₁ = 0.9, S₂ = 0.99, S₃ = 0.999, …. Sₙ yinombolo enezinhlamvu ezingu-9 ezingu-n ngemva kwephoyinti ledesimali. Inani lolu chungechunge lisondela kulo kancane kancane libhalwa 0.999…. UJiho uthe, "0.999… incane kuno-1." Sizobheka izizathu zikaJiho umugqa nomugqa esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
y-m-59-14.prereq.1: Incazelo yomkhawulo womqondo: amagama asondela ngokungapheli enombolweni
y-m-59-14.prereq.3: Isivumelwano sokuthi idesimali engapheli 0.999… liyinani lapho 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, … kuya khona
y-m-59-14.s.s1.prompt: Qala uhlulele isitatimende sikaJiho '0.999… incane kuno-1'.
y-m-59-14.s.s1.hint.0: Thola umehluko phakathi kuka-1 no-S₁, S₂, S₃ ngamunye.
y-m-59-14.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi kwenzekani kulowo mehluko njengoba n ikhula.
y-m-59-14.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. Akukho gama eliba ngu-1, ngakho umkhawulo nawo uncane kuno-1
y-m-59-14.s.s1.r.a: Uthwale isici samagama waya esicini somkhawulo njengoba sinjalo. Hlola ukuthi umkhawulo kufanele ube nesici esifanayo namagama yini.
y-m-59-14.s.s1.o.b: Kuphutha. Umkhawulo ungu-1, ngakho 0.999… no-1 yinombolo efanayo
y-m-59-14.s.s1.r.b: Wehlukanise amagama nomkhawulo. Isisekelo (ushintsho lomehluko) sokuthi lesi sinqumo silungile yini sizohlolwa ezinyathelweni ezilandelayo.
y-m-59-14.s.s1.o.c: Akunakuhlulelwa. 0.999… akuyona inombolo kodwa yinqubo eqhubeka ishintsha
y-m-59-14.s.s1.r.c: Ibone idesimali engapheli njenge-"nqubo eshintshayo" kuphela. Lo msebenzi uchaze u-0.999… njengenani lapho umqondo usondela kakhulu futhi kakhulu.
y-m-59-14.s.s1.o.d: 0.999… yinombolo ehlukile engancane noma enkulu kuno-1
y-m-59-14.s.s1.r.d: Awunqumanga ubudlelwano besayizi phakathi kuka-1 no-0.999…. Cabanga ukuthi enye inombolo ingafanela phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili yini.
y-m-59-14.s.s1.explain: Lesi sinqumo sisesiqagelo. Ake sihlole ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi 'wonke amagama angaphansi kuka-1' lisitshela ini ngomkhawulo ngokuhlola inkulumo engezansi umugqa ngomugqa.
y-m-59-14.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa onganesizathu enkulumweni kaJiho ogxumela esiphethweni.
y-m-59-14.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela kanjani emugqeni osandulela.
y-m-59-14.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola elilodwa ngelilodwa ukuthi u-"ngakho" emugqeni ngamunye ulandela ngempela emugqeni osandulela yini. Kuhle nokwenza omunye umqondo lapho wonke amagama engaphansi kwenombolo ethile (isb. 1 − 1/n) futhi uhlole ngawo.
y-m-59-14.s.s2.line.1: (1/10)^n ihlala inkulu kuno-0, ngakho Sₙ < 1 kuwo wonke n.
y-m-59-14.s.s2.line.2: Wonke amagama angaphansi kuka-1, ngakho inani elingu-0.999… lapho la magama asondela kulo ngokungapheli nalo kufanele libe ngaphansi kuka-1.
y-m-59-14.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 3 awunasizathu. Noma wonke amagama angaphansi kuka-1, umkhawulo wawo ungaba ngu-1. Isibonelo, wonke amagama ka-1 − 1/n angaphansi kuka-1, kodwa umkhawulo ungu-1. Imigqa 1 no-2 ilungile, futhi umugqa 4 uthwala nje isiphetho somugqa 3.
y-m-59-14.s.s3.prompt: Usebenzisa lokho okwenzeka ku-1 − Sₙ = (1/10)^n njengoba n ikhula, chaza ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-0.999… no-1 emshweni owodwa noma emibili.
y-m-59-14.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala emshweni owodwa ukuthi kwenzekani kulawo manani njengoba n ikhula.
